pages.text: Numbers and random values. It also has the constant $(1)c0de/math/PI$().

$(li)ABS, SGN: size and sign of a number$(li)SQR, EXP, LOG: square root, e to the power, logarithm$(li)SIN, COS, TAN, ATN: angles in radians$(li)INT, FIX, ROUND: turn a FLOAT into an INTEGER$(li)TO_FLOAT: turn an INTEGER into a FLOAT$(li)DIV: whole-number division$(li)RANDOM: a random FLOAT from 0 to below 1$(li)RANDOMIZE: set the start of the random numbers
